title: Moja uwaga wraca do mnie
sunoPrompt: Fast dub-punk with ska-rock attack, 152 BPM, springy heavy bass, jagged offbeat electric guitar, dry urgent acoustic drums and restless hand percussion. Short repeated sung refrain, live raw energy, physical stop-and-return motion. Clear natural Polish diction. Build most of the song around the repeated chorus.
